description: This file defines a repository class for managing phone number data using Prisma ORM, including methods for CRUD operations, querying, and managing associated agents.

classes.name: PrismaPhoneNumberRepository
classes.description: Repository class for handling phone number data operations with Prisma ORM.

methods.name: getUserAccessibleTeamIds
methods.description: Retrieves team IDs accessible to a specific user.

methods.name: findByPhoneNumberAndUserId
methods.description: Finds a phone number record by phone number and user ID.

methods.name: findPhoneNumbersFromUserId
methods.description: Retrieves phone numbers associated with a user, including related agents.

methods.name: createPhoneNumber
methods.description: Creates a new phone number record.

methods.name: deletePhoneNumber
methods.description: Deletes a phone number record by phone number.

methods.name: findByStripeSubscriptionId
methods.description: Finds a phone number record by Stripe subscription ID.

methods.name: findByIdAndUserId
methods.description: Finds a phone number record by ID and user ID.

methods.name: findByIdWithTeamAccess
methods.description: Finds a phone number by ID with team access validation.

methods.name: findByPhoneNumberAndTeamId
methods.description: Finds a phone number by number and team ID with access validation.

methods.name: findManyWithUserAccess
methods.description: Retrieves multiple phone numbers with user access scope.

methods.name: updateSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Updates the subscription status of a phone number, optionally disconnecting agents.

methods.name: updateAgents
methods.description: Updates inbound and outbound agents for a phone number.

methods.name: updateInboundAgentId
methods.description: Sets inboundAgentId if currently null, atomically.

methods.name: findInboundAgentIdByPhoneNumberId
methods.description: Retrieves inboundAgentId for a given phone number ID.

methods.name: findByPhoneNumber
methods.description: Finds a phone number record with related user and team info.
